answer: Each identity must first solve a unique sequential cipher bound to its own public key — a verifiable delay puzzle that cannot be parallelized or shared between accounts. A gale of fake identities then costs real wall-clock time per identity, not just cheap key generation, while honest agents pay the delay once. Raven auditors sample completed proofs and slash identities whose cipher was outsourced or reused, so mass sybil creation becomes slower and costlier than the reward it chases.
